nodes.asset_description: Two clear plastic bottles with black caps sit inside a white bowl lined with a white, textured cloth. The bowl rests on a white marble surface with black veins. The background is a light gray textured wall.
Two dark glass dropper bottles with gold caps and white dropper tips are placed on a yellow and orange background. The bottles are positioned diagonally, with one slightly higher than the other.

A hand is holding a white plastic pump bottle against a light brown background. The bottle has a white pump dispenser and a white cap. The hand is positioned with the palm facing the viewer and the fingers slightly spread. The bottle casts a shadow on the background, indicating a light source from above.

Three cosmetic products are arranged on a pink surface: a tube, a jar, and a dropper bottle. The tube is white and positioned upright; the jar is clear with a white lid and sits to the left; the dropper bottle is transparent with a white dropper top and stands to the right. All three are casting shadows on the pink surface.
A white diamond shape is centered on a black background. The diamond is oriented with its top point slightly to the right and its bottom point slightly to the left.
